category_name: Technical cleanliness, support contact, reproducibility and dependencies
score_basis: Strong native preservation, planning, resources, mesh and physical-UV work is offset by a critical unsupported notice, detached rear scanner components and exposed P2 coplanar material patches. The measured hard failure prevents acceptance regardless of the otherwise passing counters.

measured_passes.registered_anchor_note: Representative root-anchor checks do not prove every internal component contact. Detached notice/scanner parts are separately measured above.

validator_fresh_run.claim: Existing validator rerun independently; complements rather than replaces independent surface probes.

defects.title: Worker reassurance notice floats above its glazing
defects.object: CD | Joined Checkin Counter Hatch / ivory
defects.why_blocking: The thin physical notice has no attached backing, mount or glass. It violates the mandatory actual support-contact requirement in protocol14.1. Main counter floor anchors cannot validate this disconnected dressing component.
defects.repair_direction: Seat the new notice and its two reassurance text objects within the actual retained glass extent, or author a real new backing/mount that joins existing supported construction; validate that specific notice contact. Preserve inherited matrices and hatch aperture.

defects.title: Four rear scanner folded service edges have no physical connection
defects.object: CD | Joined Person Scanner Arch / steel
defects.why_blocking: The rear cosmetic folded-edge strips are detached from the chamfered scanner bodies and from their neighboring seams. This is a local construction failure; the scanner main columns remain floor supported. The four rail gaps exceed the5mm tolerance by a rigorously measured surface separation, rather than merely a bounding-box test. The six neighboring rear horizontal seam strips are also unattached, with backing gap approximately5mm.
defects.repair_direction: Reshape only the new rear service edge/seam geometry to contact the actual chamfered columns, or add seated physical bridges. Recheck actual attachment. Keep inherited scanner matrices, outer footprint and clear passage.

defects.title: Four exposed P2 guide shoes share coplanar faces with steel closures
objects: CD | Joined P2 blast leaf west / charcoal
CD | Joined P2 blast leaf west / steel
CD | Joined P2 blast leaf east / charcoal
CD | Joined P2 blast leaf east / steel
defects.why_blocking: Actual outward charcoal and steel polygons occupy the same exposed planes. All-scene rays hit both as the first surface. This is an ambiguous overlapping material boundary and an export z-fighting risk, although still-image Cycles evidence does not establish temporal flicker.
defects.repair_direction: Remove the redundant overlapping closure patches, or reshape the new guide shoes/closures into a clean stepped joint with distinct exposed surfaces; preserve inherited P2 leaf matrices and usable aperture.

defects.title: Hidden duplicate P2 center closure and embedded lower paper layers
defects.interpretation: Center steel overlap is covered by inherited P2 center seal; paper/blotter overlap is covered by the staggered top sheet. These remain redundant/intersecting internal surfaces, but they are not counted as proven exposed visual failures.
defects.repair_direction: Trim opposing new closure solids into a clean meeting seam and place the whole new dossier stack above the retained blotter top.

defects.title: Continuous fabric UV charts have local edge distortion
defects.interpretation: The consumed CD_Fabric_Cut_1m charts are noncollapsed and the tarp checker remains controlled. The upholstered seat has appreciable local distortion around its edge/side mapping; the four provided checker views do not establish the exact visibility of every distorted seat face. This is a secondary UV-quality limitation, not a missing-layer or blanket-stretch failure.
defects.repair_direction: Refine the new continuous upholstery edge charts while retaining readable textile scale and intentional seams.

unverified: No independent full factory-empty rebuild was performed; reproducibility here means retained entrypoints/hash-consistent recipes and successful cold native opening.
A complete final cold-render batch and its pixel comparison are not present in this formal batch; manifests state cold_open=false.

Fresh GitHub checkout verification was reported by root; this critic independently verified local native/resources and library manifest hashes, and does not substitute that report for own remote-run evidence.
Final-two-cycle material stability was not independently assessed against prior images in this fresh critique.
Engine import/material equivalence, collision/navmesh, dynamic mechanisms, ragdolls, load capacity, draw calls, FPS and playtesting remain unverified.

Bidirectional vertex-to-polygon distances can overestimate edge-to-edge minima; investigation cues were refined with actual rays, all-scene checks and rigorous separating-surface bounds for confirmed defects.
Coplanar search covers same-oriented planar faces on different objects; it is not exhaustive self-object or arbitrary triangle-intersection acceptance.
